chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"We seek refuge in Allah from the overpowering of debt, the overpowering of men, and the ruin of widows."
ai.seo_question: What are the three things we seek refuge from in this hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this supplication from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the socio-economic vulnerabilities of the early Muslim community, linking personal financial strain with social dynamics. The inclusion of 'ruin of widows' (bawar al-ayyim) specifically underscores the fragility of dependent families in the absence of male guardians, a key concern in Shia jurisprudence regarding inheritance and maintenance. This triad of trials reflects a holistic view of spiritual protection against both material burdens and social instability.
